english.title: Ride a pedal cycle on a road and fail to stop when directed by a uniformed police constable / traffic warden
english.legislation: Contrary to section 163(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The power of arrest and power of entry to effect arrest - by a constable in uniform - were inserted into the Act by section 49 of the Police Reform Act 2002.
(ii) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied
(iv) A Community Support Officer (CSO ) only has this power IF s/he has also been designated as a Traffic Warden
